description: Get the caller's own reputation score and trust tier. Use when a provider asks how they are rated, why their tier changed, or what their standing is — tier drives the platform commission they pay, their ranking in search, and the pricing premium they can charge, so it is the lever behind earnings rather than a vanity number. Someone who hosts no hardware comes back as a new user with no score, which is itself the answer. Read-only and free.
name: get_my_reputation
